install: In Codex, open /plugins and install pixling-proxy, then trust its hooks in /hooks
proxy.how: Command hooks: PreToolUse shows the commentary written before each tool call (from the session file, in a detached process), Stop shows the reply, PermissionRequest asks on the resident. What the user writes is queued into the session with `codex queue`, which starts a turn in an idle TUI session; UserPromptSubmit hands over anything still unread.

docs.summary: Install pixling-proxy in Codex: replies show on the resident, permission prompts become questions there, and what you write reaches the session through codex queue.
